# BriefTube

> AI-powered YouTube summaries delivered as audio to your Telegram, fully automated.

BriefTube is a B2C SaaS platform that monitors YouTube channels, generates concise AI summaries using Google Gemini, converts them to natural-sounding audio with neural TTS voices, and delivers everything to your Telegram — automatically when new videos are published.

## What BriefTube does

- Monitors YouTube channels via RSS for new videos
- Generates AI-powered text summaries with Google Gemini
- Converts summaries to audio using Microsoft Edge neural TTS (multiple voices and languages)
- Delivers audio summaries directly to your Telegram account via @brief_tube_bot
- Supports multiple languages (English, French, more coming)
- Provides shareable public links for any summary

## Pricing

- **Free**: Up to 3 YouTube channels, AI audio summaries, Telegram delivery — $0/month
- **Pro**: Unlimited channels, priority processing, custom TTS voice — $9/month
- 7-day free Pro trial on signup, no credit card required

## Telegram bot

- Bot username: @brief_tube_bot
- Connect by visiting https://www.brief-tube.com and linking your account

## Technology

- Next.js 15 (App Router) frontend hosted on Vercel
- Python worker for RSS monitoring, AI processing, and Telegram delivery
- Supabase (PostgreSQL) for database and file storage
- Google Gemini for AI summarization
- Microsoft Edge TTS for neural voice synthesis
- Stripe for subscription billing
